name: Google Analytics
summary: Run GA4 analytics reports, realtime visitor counts, and property metadata via Composio.
description: Connect Google Analytics 4 via Composio with OAuth2. Query sessions, active users, top pages, live realtime visitors, and property schema metadata directly from VoiceOS.

preferences.name: COMPOSIO_API_KEY
preferences.title: Composio API key (temporary, for testing)
preferences.description: Temporary field for testing; it will be removed before release. Leave blank to use COMPOSIO_API_KEY from the integration's .env.

preferences.name: GA4_PROPERTY_ID
preferences.title: Default GA4 property ID
preferences.description: Your 9-digit Google Analytics 4 Property ID (e.g. 123456789), found in Admin -> Property Settings.

blocks.text: Log in to Composio at dashboard.composio.dev and copy your API key from Settings -> API Keys.
In Composio (dashboard.composio.dev/apps/google_analytics), connect your Google account with Analytics Viewer access to your GA4 property.
In Google Analytics, navigate to Admin -> Property Settings. Copy your 9-digit Property ID (e.g. 123456789) and paste it below.

tools.name: run_report
tools.title: Run report
tools.description: Query GA4 metrics such as sessions, active users, and page paths.

property_id.description: GA4 property ID (digits, e.g. 123456789). Omit to use the default from Setup.

metrics.description: Metric API names to count, 1 to 10, e.g. ["activeUsers"]

dimensions.description: Dimension API names to group by, up to 9, e.g. ["pagePath"]. Omit for a single total row.

order_by.description: A metric or dimension from this request to sort by. Default: the first metric.

descending.description: Sort high to low (default true). Use false for dates in time order.

tools.name: run_realtime_report
tools.title: Run realtime report
tools.description: View live active site visitors in the last 30 minutes and top pages.

property_id.description: GA4 property ID (digits, e.g. 123456789). Omit to use the default from Setup.

metrics.description: Metric API names, up to 10. Default ["activeUsers"].

dimensions.description: Dimension API names to group by, up to 9, e.g. ["unifiedScreenName"]. Omit for a single total.

order_by.description: A metric or dimension from this request to sort by. Default: the first metric.

descending.description: Sort high to low (default true). Use false for dates in time order.

tools.name: get_metadata
tools.title: Get metadata
tools.description: List available dimensions and metrics for a Google Analytics property.

property_id.description: GA4 property ID (digits, e.g. 123456789). Omit to use the default from Setup.

category.description: Only this category, e.g. "Page / Screen", "User", "Session", "Geography", "Traffic Source", "Event".

search.description: Only fields whose API or display name contains these words, e.g. "view".
